summary: Monroe Capital Enhanced Corporate Lending Fund, a non-traded BDC, filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026 reporting that its Board of Trustees declared a $0.187 per Class I common share cash dividend, payable October 22, 2026 to holders of record at the open of business September 30, 2026, with DRIP reinvestment available. The filing also discloses August 31, 2026 NAV per Class I share of $26.20, total NAV of roughly $109.0 million, $108.1 million principal debt outstanding (0.99x debt-to-equity), no Class S or D shares outstanding, 38 portfolio companies at approximately $208.2 million fair value, and a continuous $1.0 billion registered offering. What to watch: distribution coverage versus net investment income and the external manager's valuation marks given the leveraged, floating-rate, senior-secured-heavy portfolio.
